_meta.description: D6 fixtures for openai-agents-python / gen-ui-interrupt. The tool call these fixtures emit reaches a backend tool marked needs_approval: the Agents SDK pauses the run and the backend finishes it with an AG-UI interrupt outcome. The resume leg's history carries the call plus the tool result the backend writes on resume. The tool takes only topic and attendee: candidate slots are generated by the frontend.

fixtures._comment: sales-call pill, first leg: the model calls schedule_meeting. The SDK pauses on the tool's needs_approval and the backend finishes the run with RUN_FINISHED outcome interrupt, so the picker mounts.

fixtures._comment: sales-call pill, cancelled leg. A cancel resumes with the SAME toolCallId as a pick and only the tool result differs (the adapter answers a cancel, sent as {approved: false}, with 'Tool execution was not approved.'), so gate on toolResultContains and keep this leg BEFORE the confirmation leg (first match wins).
